children: Coefficient SWVL Holdings, LLC acquired a 38.9% stake in Swvl Holdings Corp’s ordinary shares. The deal closed on Sep. 1, 2026 under a securities purchase agreement, and the Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 09, 2026. As part of the agreement, Swvl appointed Managing Partner Abdalla Ali to the board and granted governance and registration rights.

Swvl expanded its board to eight directors and appointed Abdalla Ali, who will also serve on the Compensation and Nominating and Corporate Governance committees. Coefficient SWVL Holdings, LLC secured ongoing nomination rights and the ability to name a replacement if Ali leaves, so long as the group owns at least 5% of the shares, and agreed to a lock-up that restricts sales "for a period of 180 days following the Closing Date."

The investor won preemptive rights to buy its pro rata share of new equity and obtained consent rights over key actions, including issuing preferred stock, harmful charter changes, going-private moves, delisting or deregistration, liquidation, and variable-rate financings. The filing also says the group may "consider or explore extraordinary corporate transactions" and could buy more shares or sell holdings over time.

Coefficient LP is a Delaware investment firm focused on decarbonization and the energy transition, with affiliates including Coefficient GP LLC and Coefficient SWVL Holdings, LLC. Managing Partner Abdalla Ali and CFO Youssef Shoukry lead the group from Houston, Texas. The firm backs companies where it can pair capital with governance involvement to drive operational and strategic change.
